[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a recipe for Creamy Vegan Mac and Cheese with Cashew Cream, including ingredients and instructions.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Recipe details for Creamy Vegan Mac and Cheese with Cashew Cream:  
- For cashew cream: 1 cup of cashews, 1/2 cup of water, 1 tablespoon of lemon juice, 1/2 teaspoon of salt.  
- For mac and cheese: 1 pound of macaroni, 2 tablespoons of olive oil, 1 small onion (diced), 2 cloves of garlic (minced), 2 cups of vegetable broth, 1 cup of cashew cream, 1 teaspoon of apple cider vinegar, 1/2 teaspoon of Dijon mustard, 1/2 teaspoon of paprika, 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper, 1 cup of vegan cheddar cheese shreds, fresh parsley or thyme for garnish (optional).
